primary_findings.de_novo_final: Graph encoder plus causal decoder context: balanced useful yield 62.037% UMA / 63.455% MACE versus 58.623% / 57.292% mutation. Latent contribution remains unresolved: KL 0.007–0.011 nats and weak z sensitivity.
primary_findings.editor: Same-seed, same-k, shared-uniform assessment: balanced yield 59.375% versus 57.234%; fixed-q20 low-request yield 50.347% versus 50.521%. Best novel low child favors learned editing in 7/9 cases posthoc; the paired mean favors mutation by 0.07656 meV/atom. Both observables are retained.
primary_findings.aggregate_prior: Posthoc TRAIN posterior-moment Gaussian improves balanced dense-CVAE yield under both teachers but worsens original-q20LOW; not a jointly trained conditional prior.
primary_findings.temperature: All four temperatures yield identical integer request schedules and paired structures; low reference ESS and no physical temperature-response claim.
primary_findings.NEB: Event1 coarse/refined forward spans: 0.638221/0.188711 eV per hop. Coupled image/tolerance/path sensitivity is unresolved. Event2 coarse span: 0.191544 eV/hop. Seven MACE single points use the coarse first UMA band only.
